highlights.title: Iglua Órdenes
highlights.body: A field-operations SaaS for service orders and technical support tickets. Five core microservices on a hybrid SQL/NoSQL architecture — relational integrity where orders need it, document storage where client-driven templates need to stay flexible.

highlights.title: Reporting engine
highlights.body: Built with Hono and I/O streams. This is the piece that took the company's core business process off physical paper and into the product — the migration, not just the feature.

highlights.title: A production reliability fix
highlights.body: The reporting pods were spiking memory under load in Kubernetes. I traced it to unbounded concurrency and added a strict max-concurrency mechanism, which flattened RAM usage under heavy traffic.

highlights.title: A centralized query engine
highlights.body: Filtering, pagination, and date-range parameters used to mean several round trips. I consolidated them into single-trip API calls, cutting network overhead across every consuming service.

highlights.title: Backend migration
highlights.body: Led the migration of a new core service onto an InversifyJS dependency-injection architecture, so wiring is declared rather than hand-constructed and services can be swapped in tests.

highlights.title: Angular frontends
highlights.body: Built with Signals and Reactive Forms to keep Zone.js overhead down, with PrimeNG for the heavier views — dynamic calendars, historical template comparisons.
